== Education and career ==
She studied [[physics]] at the [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]] and completed a PhD in [[Spectroscopy#molecules|molecular spectroscopy]] in 1973. She began her career as a researcher at [[Inserm]], where she was involved in the development of the first digital scanner in nuclear medicine. She then joined the Frédéric-Joliot hospital department of the [[French Alternative Energies and Atomic Energy Commission]] where she developed [[Positron emission tomography]] locally as part of a second thesis in biophysics completed in 1984 at the [[University of Paris-Sud]] under the direction of Nobel Prize winner [[Georges Charpak]]. She became associate professor in Physics and Medical Biophysics at the Pierre and Marie Curie University and the [[University of Paris-Sud]].<ref name="Femmes et Sciences">{{cite web|url=https://www.femmesetsciences.fr/wp-content/uploads/2013/03/ASSEMBLAGE4_F5.pdf|title=La recherche du laboratoire à l'entreprise : le parcours, guidé par l'innovation, d'une physiciennedans le domaine de la santéFrançoise Soussaline, fondatrice et PDG de la société IMSTAR, Prix Irène Joliot-Curie 2010, parcours femme entreprise|website=www.femmesetsciences.fr|access-date=26 November 2019|archive-date=24 April 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170424010410/http://www.femmesetsciences.fr/wp-content/uploads/2013/03/ASSEMBLAGE4_F5.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In 1985, she founded the company IMSTAR, which designs, develops and markets automated imaging systems for [[List of life sciences|life-sciences]] research and [[Medical test#Diagnostic|diagnostic tests]] for [[genetic disorder]]s and cancers.<ref name="Femmes et Sciences"/><ref name="Prix Irène Joliot-Curie">{{cite web|url=https://www.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/cid52213/www.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/cid52213/www.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/cid52213/remise-du-prix-irene-joliot-curie-2010.html|title=Prix Irène Joliot-Curie 2010|website=www.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr|access-date=24 November 2019}}</ref>

From 1994 to 2008, she served as the president of BioCRITT Ile de France

Between 2007 and 2009, she was vice-president of the [[:fr:Pôles de compétitivité en Île-de-France]] [[:fr:Medicen]] (Medicen [business] competition clusters in the ''Île-de-France'' region). She is also a member of the supervisory board of the [[:fr:Centre régional d'innovation et de transfert de technologie#CRITT par régions|Paris Region Innovation Centre]].<ref name="Femmes et Sciences"/><ref>{{cite web|url=http://femmesmonde.com/francoise-soussaline/3999397|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131219222719/http://femmesmonde.com/francoise-soussaline/3999397|archive-date=19 December 2013|url-status=dead|title=Femmes Monde à la Coupole|website=archive.wikiwix.com|access-date=26 November 2019}}</ref>

She is an active supporter of equality for women in science. She has been part of the association ''[[:fr:Femmes et Sciences]]'' since its creation in 2000 and promotes science as a career choice amongst girls in secondary schools.<ref name="Femmes et Sciences"/>

==Recognition==
* 1997: Chevalière de l'[[ordre national de la Légion d'honneur]] (''Knight of the National Order of the Legion of Honour''], for 27 years' professional service.<ref>[https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/affichTexte.do?cidTexte=JORFTEXT000000199827 Décret du 28 mars 1997 portant promotion et nomination]</ref>
* 2001: Officière de l'[[ordre national de la Légion d'honneur]] (''Officer of the National Order of the Legion of Honour''], for 30 years' professional activities.<ref>[https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/affichTexte.do?cidTexte=JORFTEXT000000589332 Décret du 14 mai 2001 portant promotion et nomination]</ref>
* 2010: [[Irène Joliot-Curie Prize]] dans la catégorie ''parcours femme entreprise'' [Irène-Joliot-Curie prize for women's business innovation in science].<ref name="Prix Irène Joliot-Curie"/>
